plan.summary: BRO-6306: add commercial records for seven 2016-17 and 2017-18 shows whose outcome a published source confirms (fills the season coverage gap so both seasons show on /biz)

actions.description: angels-in-america: add commercial entry (2018 revival closed without recouping)

entry.recoupedSource: Broadway News (Dec 19, 2019), on two-part plays including the 2018 Angels in America revival: "apart from 'Nicholas Nickleby,' none of the shows have recouped during their commercial runs." https://www.broadwaynews.com/the-risks-and-rewards-of-two-part-plays-on-broadway/
entry.notes: Two-part revival from the National Theatre at the Neil Simon (opened Mar 25, 2018, closed Jul 15, 2018). Won the Tony for Best Revival of a Play but did not recoup during its commercial run. No capitalization was published.

actions.description: the-terms-of-my-surrender-2017: add commercial entry (closed at a loss)

entry.recoupedSource: Forbes (Feb 6, 2018): Michael Moore's solo show "grossed less than half its potential, and closed at a loss to investors." https://www.forbes.com/sites/leeseymour/2018/02/06/john-leguizamos-latin-history-for-morons-recoups-investment-on-broadway/
entry.notes: Michael Moore's limited-engagement solo show at the Belasco (opened Aug 10, 2017, closed Oct 22, 2017). No capitalization was published.

actions.description: a-dolls-house-part-2-2017: add commercial entry (closed at a loss)

entry.recoupedSource: Forbes (Oct 23, 2017), on the spring 2017 plays: "The rest have shuttered, most ahead of their planned dates and at a financial loss, including A Doll's House, Part 2." https://www.forbes.com/sites/leeseymour/2017/10/23/the-state-of-plays-on-broadway/
entry.notes: Lucas Hnath's play at the John Golden (opened Apr 27, 2017, closed Sep 24, 2017). Laurie Metcalf won the Tony for Best Actress in a Play. No capitalization was published.

actions.description: charlie-and-the-chocolate-factory-2017: add commercial entry ($17.5M capitalization, did not recoup, $850K weekly operating cost)

entry.capitalizationSource: Forbes (Apr 10, 2017): "With a $17.5m capitalization, it's the most expensive new musical on the docket." https://www.forbes.com/sites/leeseymour/2017/04/10/broadway-box-office-points-to-awards-season-bloodbath/
entry.weeklyRunningCostSource: Forbes (Mar 28, 2019): "its weekly ticket sales soon slipped underneath its $850,000 weekly operating costs" https://www.forbes.com/sites/marchershberg/2019/03/28/as-beetlejuice-begins-to-haunt-broadway-warner-bros-faces-intense-scrutiny/
entry.recoupedSource: Forbes (Mar 28, 2019): "The show did not recoup its initial investment." https://www.forbes.com/sites/marchershberg/2019/03/28/as-beetlejuice-begins-to-haunt-broadway-warner-bros-faces-intense-scrutiny/
entry.notes: Warner Bros.' revised version of the London musical at the Lunt-Fontanne (opened Apr 23, 2017, closed Jan 14, 2018). Sold about $1M a week in its first four months, then fell below its weekly operating cost.

actions.description: indecent-2017: add commercial entry ($3.8M SEC capitalization, a flop)

entry.capitalizationSource: Broadway Journal (Jun 19, 2017): "it was capitalized at $3.8 million, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission." https://www.broadwayjournal.com/p/from-oslo-to-come-from-away-tonys-provide-bounce
entry.recoupedSource: Broadway Journal (Jun 19, 2017): "One of several flops in a punishing season for plays." https://www.broadwayjournal.com/p/from-oslo-to-come-from-away-tonys-provide-bounce
entry.notes: Paula Vogel's play at the Cort (opened Apr 18, 2017). It posted a closing notice for Jun 25, won Tonys for direction and lighting, then extended and closed Aug 6, 2017. The $3.8M is the SEC filing figure.

actions.description: present-laughter-2017: add commercial entry (did not recoup)

entry.recoupedSource: Forbes (Jul 6, 2017): "And while Present Laughter didn't recoup its costs, it remained the highest-grossing play on Broadway each week save one." https://www.forbes.com/sites/leeseymour/2017/07/06/bette-midlers-absence-wallops-broadway-box-office/
entry.notes: Kevin Kline-led limited revival at the St. James (opened Apr 5, 2017, closed Jul 2, 2017). Kline won the Tony for Best Actor in a Play. No capitalization was published.

actions.description: amelie-a-new-musical-2017: add commercial entry (lost its $12M capitalization)

entry.capitalizationSource: Forbes (May 8, 2017): Amélie "will close May 21st, losing its $12 million capitalization." https://www.forbes.com/sites/leeseymour/2017/05/08/amelie-is-first-to-close-after-tony-nominations-shake-broadway-box-office/
entry.recoupedSource: Forbes (May 8, 2017): "will close May 21st, losing its $12 million capitalization." https://www.forbes.com/sites/leeseymour/2017/05/08/amelie-is-first-to-close-after-tony-nominations-shake-broadway-box-office/
entry.notes: Musical adaptation of the 2001 film at the Walter Kerr (opened Apr 3, 2017, closed May 21, 2017). Received no Tony nominations and closed weeks later.
